input._script:
using MPI
using CUDA
using JSON3

function jacc_vadd_i(i, y, a, b)
    y[i] = a[i] + b[i]
end

MPI.Init()
comm = MPI.COMM_WORLD
rank = MPI.Comm_rank(comm)
nranks = MPI.Comm_size(comm)

input = JSON3.read(ARGS[1])
a_host = Float32.(input.a)
b_host = Float32.(input.b)
n = length(a_host)

local_result = Dict{String,Any}()

# --- raw CUDA.jl on this rank's local GPU ---
try
    CUDA.device!(0)
    function vadd_kernel!(y, a, b)
        i = (blockIdx().x - 1) * blockDim().x + threadIdx().x
        if i <= length(y)
            @inbounds y[i] = a[i] + b[i]
        end
        return nothing
    end
    a_dev = CuArray(a_host)
    b_dev = CuArray(b_host)
    y_dev = CUDA.zeros(Float32, n)
    threads = 256
    blocks = cld(n, threads)
    @cuda threads=threads blocks=blocks vadd_kernel!(y_dev, a_dev, b_dev)
    CUDA.synchronize()
    local_result["cuda"] = Dict("result" => Array(y_dev), "device" => CUDA.name(CUDA.device()))
catch e
    local_result["cuda"] = Dict("error" => sprint(showerror, e))
end

# --- JACC.jl on this rank's local GPU (unverified convention) ---
# import must be its own completed top-level statement before any
# code that uses JACC.@macro: Julia macro-expands an entire top-level
# block before executing any of it, so import JACC and JACC.@init_backend
# cannot share one try block -- the macro would resolve before the
# import has run.
try
    ENV["JACC_BACKEND"] = "CUDA"
    import JACC
catch e
    local_result["jacc"] = Dict("error" => "import JACC failed: $(sprint(showerror, e))")
end
if !haskey(local_result, "jacc")
    try
        JACC.@init_backend
        a_j = JACC.array(a_host)
        b_j = JACC.array(b_host)
        y_j = JACC.zeros(Float32, n)
        # JACC.parallel_for(dims, f, x...) calls f(i, x...) per index.
        # f must be a named function -- confirmed via methods(JACC.parallel_for)
        # on 2026-09-05; JACC's macro form and JACC.Array do not exist as
        # this health check originally assumed.
        JACC.parallel_for(n, jacc_vadd_i, y_j, a_j, b_j)
        JACC.synchronize()
        local_result["jacc"] = Dict("result" => Array(y_j))
    catch e
        local_result["jacc"] = Dict("error" => sprint(showerror, e))
    end
end

# --- CUDA-aware MPI test: device buffer straight across nodes, no host
# copy. Same check as the gpua30 multi_node health check. ---
mpi_result = Dict{String,Any}()
try
    if nranks < 2
        mpi_result["error"] = "expected 2 MPI ranks, got $nranks"
    else
        CUDA.device!(0)
        buf = CUDA.fill(Float32(rank), 4)
        if rank == 0
            MPI.Send(buf, comm; dest=1, tag=0)
            mpi_result["sent"] = true
        elseif rank == 1
            MPI.Recv!(buf, comm; source=0, tag=0)
            mpi_result["received"] = Array(buf)
        end
    end
catch e
    mpi_result["error"] = sprint(showerror, e)
end

hostname = gethostname()

# Node identity and CUDA versions, recorded before any kernel launch.
# A SIGSEGV inside cuModuleLoadDataEx killed the multi-GPU a30 check on
# 2026-09-05 and passed on retry. The crash is not catchable, so the
# result JSON is lost and the node stays unknown. These fields go into
# the Slurm log instead, which survives the crash, and into the result
# when the job completes. A driver older than the runtime is the first
# thing to check for a module-load fault.
node_info = Dict{String,Any}("hostname" => gethostname())
try
    node_info["driver"]  = string(CUDA.driver_version())
    node_info["runtime"] = string(CUDA.runtime_version())
catch e
    node_info["versions_error"] = sprint(showerror, e)
end
println(stderr, "NODE: ", node_info)
flush(stderr)

this_rank_payload = Dict("hostname" => hostname, "node" => node_info,
                         "local" => local_result, "mpi" => mpi_result)

# Only rank 0 prints. rank 1 sends its payload to rank 0 over MPI so the
# one printed line carries both ranks' results.
if rank == 0
    final = Dict{String,Any}("rank0" => this_rank_payload)
    if nranks >= 2
        try
            final["rank1"] = MPI.recv(comm; source=1, tag=1)
        catch e
            final["rank1"] = Dict("error" => "failed to receive rank 1's payload: $(sprint(showerror, e))")
        end
    end
    println(JSON3.write(final))
elseif rank == 1
    MPI.send(this_rank_payload, comm; dest=0, tag=1)
end
